title: Iranian-Born Investor Yasmin Razavi Secures Multi-Billion-Dollar Windfall in Anthropic IPO
tldr: Following AI lab Anthropic's historic market debut on the Nasdaq, prominent Iranian-born venture capitalist and Anthropic board member Yasmin Razavi gained widespread recognition for steering Spark Capital's early bet on the company. Her initial $75 million investment on behalf of Spark Capital has yielded an estimated multi-billion-dollar return.

title: Pardeh Restaurant Opens in Bethnal Green with Contemporary Persian Dining
tldr: Entrepreneur Sahar Gilabadi opened Pardeh, a contemporary Persian restaurant and dedicated listening bar in East London's Bethnal Green. Developed in consultation with Iranian chef Yma Apa, the dining concept blends traditional Iranian recipes such as ghorme sabzi and saffron-infused dishes with classical European culinary techniques.

title: Startups founded by Persian expats or Persian-Americans that raised $10M+
tldr: Dealroom released a market map highlighting venture-backed tech startups founded by Iranian diaspora and Iranian-American entrepreneurs that have raised $10 million or more. The landscape highlights companies across sectors such as artificial intelligence, enterprise software, and developer tools.

title: Zoox robotaxis are now on the Uber app in Las Vegas
tldr: Uber, led by Iranian-born CEO Dara Khosrowshahi, launched commercial ride matching with Amazon-owned Zoox robotaxis in Las Vegas, marking the first time Zoox has opened its fleet to a third-party app. Khosrowshahi stated that Las Vegas has become the first city offering two driverless fleets on Uber's platform, previewing plans to eventually introduce a dedicated autonomous dispatch option.

title: NexScale Founder Dr. Soodeh Farokhi Delivers Industry Address on AI Retention Systems
tldr: Dr. Soodeh Farokhi, Iranian-Canadian founder and CEO of Toronto-based AI startup NexScale, presented at a national session co-hosted with the Fitness Industry Council of Canada. She outlined how autonomous agentic intelligence and predictive analytics allow subscription and wellness operators to preempt user churn.

title: Who is Saber Kordestanchi? The Hostaway co-founder who became Finland's third-highest earner
tldr: Official Finnish tax data revealed that Iranian-born entrepreneur and Hostaway co-founder Saber Kordestanchi ranked third among Finland's highest earners with €42.5 million in taxable income. The vast majority of his earnings came from capital gains through secondary share sales to private equity investors following the vacation rental platform's rise to unicorn status.

title: Ex-Anthropic Researchers' AI Lab Mirendil Raises $1B Series A
tldr: San Francisco-based frontier AI laboratory Mirendil, co-founded by Iranian-born CEO Behnam Neyshabur and Iranian researcher Tara Rezaei alongside Harsh Mehta, closed a $1 billion Series A round co-led by Kleiner Perkins and Clearlake Capital. The startup develops autonomous AI agents designed to automate complex, end-to-end scientific research and artificial intelligence development workflows.

title: An Iranian refugee arrived with $75 and built a multimillion-dollar business. Now he's helping others this National Entrepreneurship Month.
tldr: Payam Zamani, the founder and CEO of One Planet Group, shared insights on his journey building multimillion-dollar businesses after arriving in the United States as a refugee with only $75. In recognition of National Entrepreneurship Month, he outlined core decision-making frameworks to guide and mentor early-stage entrepreneurs.
